title: The Locker of Cedar Falls
author: Noor Hartwell
blurb: Ines Amberdale, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
